title: Small Golf, Growing Crowds
titleZh: 小小高尔夫，吸引越来越多人
paras: A surprising sports trend is growing in Bellwick: adults are spending Friday evenings playing miniature golf inside an old furniture workshop. The club began with eight members last winter. Now, forty people attend, including visitors from two [[neighboring|neighboring]] villages. Many come for the building work as much as the game.

The club's evenings [[consist|consist]] of two parts. First, members [[combine|combine]] pieces of wood to build small bridges and slopes. Then they play a round on their new course. Players carefully [[select|select]] a route for each shot. Moving a wooden edge by just one [[millimetre|millimetre]] can change where the ball goes.

For retired cook Amira, the attraction is the [[connection|connection]] between making things and playing sport. She stopped playing tennis after a knee injury. 'I sometimes needed a [[painkiller|painkiller]] after a match,' she explains. 'Here, I can sit down between turns and still be part of a team.' However, winning remains important: members keep scores on a large board.

A [[planned|planned]] open evening next month will let visitors try the course for free. The club is also preparing its first [[annual|annual]] competition. Its prize is a tiny wooden bridge, a [[symbol|symbol]] of the friendships built there. In Bellwick, a smaller playing field has created a surprisingly large sporting community.
zh: 贝尔威克正兴起一股令人意外的运动潮流：成年人每周五晚上都会到一间旧家具作坊里打迷你高尔夫。俱乐部去年冬天刚成立时只有八名会员，如今已有四十人参加，其中还有来自两个邻近村庄的人。对许多人来说，动手搭建球道和打球同样有吸引力。
俱乐部的晚间活动由两部分组成。首先，会员们把木块拼在一起，搭出小桥和斜坡。接着，他们就在新建的球道上打一轮。每次击球前，球员都会仔细选择路线。即使只把木质边缘移动一毫米，也可能改变球的走向。
对退休厨师阿米拉来说，吸引她的是动手制作与体育运动之间的联系。膝盖受伤后，她就不再打网球了。她解释说：“以前打一场比赛后，我有时得吃止痛药。在这里，我可以在轮到别人打球时坐下来休息，同时仍然是团队的一员。”不过，获胜依然很重要：会员们会把比分记录在一块大板上。
下个月预先安排好的一场开放夜活动将让访客免费体验球道。俱乐部也正在筹备首届年度比赛。奖品是一座小木桥，象征着大家在这里建立的友谊。在贝尔威克，更小的运动场地却凝聚起了一个规模大得令人意外的运动社群。

q.s: The club advertises its Friday evenings in a local newspaper.
q.why: 文章未说明俱乐部是否在当地报纸上宣传。

q.s: Members play their round before starting the construction work.
q.why: 第二段说明先搭建球道，再打球。

q.s: Amira can sit down between turns at the club.
q.why: 第三段中她说可以在两次轮到自己之间坐下。
